summary: Adds snap-to-nearest-item to an ordinary ScrollRect.
overview: Drop it beside a ScrollRect whose content uses a layout group with evenly sized items. Dragging behaves exactly like a normal ScrollRect; releasing eases to the nearest item.
useCases: A horizontal page or level selector.
Any list where items should land centred rather than anywhere.

params.tuning: Too slow feels unresponsive; too fast removes the sense of momentum entirely.

gotchas.title: Items must be evenly sized
gotchas.body: The snap target is computed from uniform spacing. Mixed sizes land in the wrong places.
